(3) PREMISE INTERNALIZATION VIA KL, NOT CE (arXiv:2412.14964): for masked rows, the target is the token-level KL to the SAME model's output distribution WITH the premise in-prompt (teacher logits precomputable once per row, cacheable), not one-hot CE — measured to be far more sample-efficient and to work at LoRA r=16. (4) INJECTION POINT: splice the latent as per-layer K,V values (500xCompressor: KV beats embedding injection for content preservation into a frozen decoder) and keep the decoder prompt SHORT relative to the prefix (Prefix-Tuning+ dilution); alternatively add the prefix contribution outside the attention softmax. (5) CAPACITY: r=16 is in the measured 'learns less' regime for math; CODI used r=128 a=32. Within the 132M budget, prefer r=64-128 with alpha=2r on q,k,v,o + MLP of ALL layers over any width elsewhere — all-module targeting is worth more than 16x rank (2405.09673). (6) OPTIMIZATION: CODI's effective batch was 128; at batch 1 x accum 4 the distillation gradient is noise — raise grad-accum to >=32 even at the cost of steps, cosine schedule, 3% warmup, lr ~5e-4-1e-3 for the LoRA at 0.6B. (7) EXPERTS/LANES transfer of the same principle: give each expert/lane its OWN dense distillation target = hidden states over a distinct gold-trace SEGMENT (e.g. lane A aligns to the premise-extraction span, lane B to the computation span) via per-lane L1 losses — necessity by supervision, not by penalty; this is the CODI mechanism applied per-stream and is the only literature-consistent way to force stream differentiation at this data scale. (8) PREREGISTER SoftCoT-SIZED EFFECTS: +1-3 pts over a no-prefix/shuffled-prefix control and a text-assist control (Zero-Shot Assist-CoT analog), NOT CoT parity — parity required 385k rows and 36-48 A100-hours everywhere it was measured.
lenses.feasibility_at_our_budget: Split verdict. (a) Is 132M LoRA on a frozen 0.6B mechanistically ENOUGH to teach the decoder to consume a supervised latent prefix? YES, with direct measured evidence: CODI does exactly this with LoRA r=128 on frozen GPT-2 (124M) and LLaMA-3.2-1B, reaching 99%/90% of explicit-CoT SFT; ICAE/500xCompressor show even a ZERO-trainable-param frozen reader consumes latent tokens when the writer is trained through it with reconstruction loss. Unfrozen attention is not required; the lens's premise that CODI fully fine-tunes is wrong (Coconut does, CODI doesn't). (b) Is it feasible at 7.5k-50k rows and 6.5 T4-hours? NOT for CoT-parity-level internalization: every parity result used 240k-385k rows and 36-48+ A100-hours (HLWM's budget is ~1.5-2 epochs over 7.5k rows on hardware ~4-8x slower per hour — roughly 100x less data-seen than CODI). The only positive evidence at HLWM's exact data scale is SoftCoT: frozen everything, one linear projection over GROUNDED (pretrained-LM-derived) soft tokens, +1.3-2.1 pts on GSM8K — and ~1 pt of that is reproducible with a plain-text assistant summary. Prompt distillation adds that KL-to-self-teacher works at r=16 with thousands of examples. So v10 can honestly target: a latent prefix that measurably HELPS (+1-3 pts vs shuffled-prefix control) and passes a necessity ablation, using grounded tokens + CODI-style hidden-state alignment + KL distillation. It cannot honestly target 'latent workspace replaces the reasoning chain' at this budget; no paper shows that below ~200k rows even with full fine-tuning. Also note 0.6B-specific headroom: SoftCoT's gains were measured on 7-8B backbones with strong zero-shot CoT; Qwen3-0.6B's weaker base competence makes a null result plausible.
risks: Data-scale extrapolation is the whole bet: no paper demonstrates CODI-style latent-CoT internalization below 385k rows; at 7.5k rows the mechanism may simply undertrain (CODI needed 40 epochs at batch 128; HLWM gets ~2 epochs at batch 4).

Effect-size floor vs HLWM's gate structure: the only budget-matched positive (SoftCoT) is +1.3-2.1 pts with ~1 pt attributable to plain-text assist — a preregistered gate demanding a large channel effect will fail even if the mechanism works exactly as published.

Prefix dilution is structural (arXiv:2506.13674): a 42-token prefix inside softmax attention over a long prompt loses influence regardless of training; if v10 keeps long prompts + embedding-level splice, the published failure mode reproduces HLWM's probe-decodes-but-decoder-ignores signature.

r=16 is in the measured 'learns less' regime for math (arXiv:2405.09673); raising to r=64-128 with alpha=2r may be necessary and changes the disclosed trainable-param count (+ possible T4 memory pressure with the teacher pass in-batch.)

Tiny-batch distillation noise: CODI's L1 hidden-state loss and PD's KL were tuned at effective batch >=128; at grad-accum 4 these auxiliary gradients may be dominated by variance — budget must buy accumulation, and gamma needs retuning (CODI saw 46.5->51.9 just moving beta 1->20 at 1B).

Qwen3-0.6B specifics untested: no-BOS/eos aliasing already caused one HLWM root-cause failure; CODI's designated-token alignment and SoftCoT's [UNK]-placeholder scheme both assume tokenizer behaviors that must be re-verified on Qwen3 chat template before committing GPU hours.

lenses.lens: ADVERSARIAL SKEPTIC — strongest published evidence against latent-space reasoning, and the controls that make v10 unfoolable

papers.title: Think before you speak: Training Language Models With Pause Tokens
papers.scale_tested: Decoder-only 130M and 1B, pretrained on C4 with pause tokens then finetuned; 8 downstream tasks
papers.core_mechanism: Appends learnable content-free <pause> tokens; gains attributed to extra parallel computation width, NOT semantic content of the tokens
papers.measured_result: 1B pause-pretrained+finetuned: +18% EM SQuAD, +8% CommonSenseQA, +1% GSM8k. CRITICAL NEGATIVE: pause-finetuning-only on a standard-pretrained model gives mixed/near-zero gains, and inference-time-only pauses give none. Direct threat to any latent-prefix add-on over a FROZEN base like Qwen3-0.6B.

papers.title: Let's Think Dot by Dot: Hidden Computation in Transformer Language Models
papers.scale_tested: Small transformers (LLaMA-style, from scratch) on synthetic 3SUM/2SUM algorithmic tasks
papers.core_mechanism: Meaningless filler tokens ('......') replace CoT; shows CoT-shaped gains can be pure compute
papers.measured_result: 3SUM: 100% with fillers vs 66% without — with ZERO reasoning content in the tokens. Learning to use fillers required dense, task-specific, parallelizable-decomposition supervision; theory limits benefit to parallelizable (bounded quantifier-depth) problems. Predicts a compute-matched pause arm could reproduce any workspace gain on our numeric/ordering families.

papers.title: Training Large Language Models to Reason in a Continuous Latent Space (Coconut)
papers.scale_tested: GPT-2 (124M), multi-stage curriculum; GSM8k, ProntoQA, ProsQA (authors' own benchmark)
papers.core_mechanism: Feed last hidden state back as next input embedding (continuous thought), curriculum replacing CoT steps with latents
papers.measured_result: GSM8k 34.1% — LOSES to explicit CoT 42.9% (no-CoT 16.5%). Wins only on ProntoQA (99.8 vs 98.8) and self-created ProsQA (97.0 vs 77.5). Community ablation critique: 'pause-as-thought' variant ≈ full Coconut, and no-thought curriculum-only ablation barely significantly worse — the headline mechanism is weakly separated from its own controls.

papers.title: Do Latent Tokens Think? A Causal and Adversarial Analysis of Chain-of-Continuous-Thought
papers.scale_tested: Coconut-style models incl. LLaMA-3-8B scale comparisons; MMLU, HotpotQA, steering/perturbation protocol
papers.core_mechanism: Causal steering of latent vs CoT tokens + biased/OOD shortcut probes
papers.measured_result: Coconut latents show minimal steering sensitivity (CoT tokens up to ~50% sensitivity on LLaMA-3-8B) and 'lack reasoning-critical information'; on MMLU/HotpotQA Coconut consistently exploits dataset artifacts — repositioned as 'pseudo-reasoning': placeholders + shortcut dependence. Predicts our pattern exactly: latents carry probe-decodable content but are causally inert for generation.

papers.title: How Do Latent Reasoning Methods Perform Under Weak and Strong Supervision?
papers.scale_tested: Systematic evaluation across Coconut/CODI/SIM-CoT-class methods on multi-step reasoning tasks
papers.core_mechanism: Interventional evaluation: disable latent depth, attention analysis, BFS-hypothesis tests
papers.measured_result: Pervasive shortcut behavior — accuracy often stays high with latent reasoning entirely disabled (depth=0); BFS-in-latent-space hypothesis fails (implicit pruning/compression, not search); trade-off: strong step supervision kills shortcuts but collapses latent hypothesis diversity; weak supervision preserves diversity but invites shortcuts.

papers.title: SIM-CoT: Supervised Implicit Chain-of-Thought
papers.scale_tested: GPT-2 124M and LLaMA-3.1-8B, GSM8k-class math; plug-in on Coconut and CODI
papers.core_mechanism: Diagnoses latent collapse: as latent token count scales, representations become HOMOGENEOUS and training collapses due to missing step-level supervision. Fix: auxiliary decoder aligns EACH latent token to its explicit gold reasoning step (decoder dropped at inference)
papers.measured_result: +8.2% over Coconut on GPT-2, +3.0% over CODI on LLaMA-3.1-8B; stabilizes training at larger latent budgets. The homogenization diagnosis is the published twin of our lanes converging to cosine 0.94-0.98 in 9/9 attempts.

papers.title: CODI: Compressing Chain-of-Thought into Continuous Space via Self-Distillation
papers.scale_tested: GPT-2 124M (LoRA r128, lr 3e-3, 40 epochs, ~36h on 1×A100-80GB) and LLaMA-3.2-1B (10 epochs, ~48h A100); GSM8k-Aug = 385,620 rows
papers.core_mechanism: Shared model as teacher (explicit gold CoT) and student (6 latent tokens); feature-level distillation aligning hidden states at the answer-generating token across all layers; single-stage (no curriculum)
papers.measured_result: GSM8k 43.7% at 124M — first implicit CoT to match explicit CoT (42.9%) at GPT-2 scale; 3.1x compression; beats CoT-SFT OOD on SVAMP/GSM-Hard/MultiArith. Existence proof that dense distillation makes a latent channel work at our MODEL scale — but at ~50x our data and ~15x our compute.

papers.title: On the Representation Collapse of Sparse Mixture of Experts
papers.scale_tested: Cross-lingual LM pretraining + 7 multilingual benchmarks (base-size transformers, 32 experts)
papers.core_mechanism: Linear routing on raw hidden states drives token clustering around expert centroids → representation collapse; balance loss constrains only marginal load and CANNOT prevent experts learning identical selection rules; fix = low-dim projected, L2-normalized routing with gating temperature (X-MoE)
papers.measured_result: X-MoE gives consistent gains and measurably more consistent routing vs baseline SMoE; follow-ups confirm softmax saturation zeroes auxiliary-loss gradients (raising aux coefficient 0.01→0.08 had no measurable effect on collapsed layers) — matches our inert diversity penalties and 3/3 route collapses.

papers.title: Mixtral of Experts (+ 'The Myth of Expert Specialization', arXiv:2604.09780)
papers.scale_tested: Mixtral 8x7B (47B params, trillions of tokens) analyzed over The Pile subsets
papers.core_mechanism: Post-hoc analysis of learned top-2 routing in a fully-trained production MoE
papers.measured_result: NO semantic/domain expert specialization even at 47B: expert-selection proportions near-uniform across Pile domains (mild deviation only on DM Mathematics); routing aligns with syntax and shows temporal locality in deep layers. 2604.09780: routing reflects hidden-state GEOMETRY, deep layers route semantically unrelated inputs near-identically. If 47B + massive data doesn't yield semantic experts emergently, 0.6B + 7.5k rows never will — routing must be supervised, not learned.

papers.title: A Silver Bullet or a Compromise for Full Attention? A Comprehensive Study of Gist Token-based Context Compression (+ arXiv:2503.19114 Amazon information-preservation study)
papers.scale_tested: Gist-compression architectures on LLaMA-class models across QA/synthetic recall tasks; 2503.19114 evaluates SOTA soft+hard compressors on long-context tasks
papers.core_mechanism: Compress context into few gist/soft tokens; probe whether compressed representations retain original content
papers.measured_result: Three replicated failure patterns: 'lost by the boundary', 'lost if surprise', 'lost along the way'; probing shows gist tokens struggle to RECONSTRUCT original content — fixed only by adding an explicit autoencoding loss. 2503.19114: SOTA soft/hard compression fails to preserve key details (entities) at high ratios; granularity control recovers up to +23% downstream, 2.7x entities. Our 42-token latent prefix is a gist compressor; content loss under compression is the documented default.

papers.title: LLMs Know More About Numbers than They Can Say (+ 'The Detection-Extraction Gap', arXiv:2604.06613)
papers.scale_tested: Open-weight LLMs (incl. Qwen-class), numerical comparison tasks; linear logistic probes on hidden states
papers.core_mechanism: Probe-vs-verbalization gap: linear probe on hidden states vs model's generated answer on identical items
papers.measured_result: Probes reliably decode which number is larger even when generation is 50-70% (near the 50% floor) — internal computation exists but is not verbalizable. 2604.06613: models 'know' the answer before they can say it; extraction fails on ~half of problems where the answer is internally recoverable. Independent replication of our probe 0.30 / generation 0.000 signature — it is a known, generic decoder-interface failure, not evidence the workspace 'almost works'.

papers.title: Generating Sentences from a Continuous Space (posterior collapse; + He et al. 'Lagging Inference Networks', arXiv:1901.05534)
papers.scale_tested: LSTM-VAE on Penn Treebank / Books corpus (canonical small scale)
papers.core_mechanism: When the decoder is a strong autoregressive LM, the KL term drives q(z|x) to the prior → z ignored; mitigations: KL annealing, word dropout (decoder weakening), aggressive inference-network updates
papers.measured_result: KL → 0 (latent carries ~0 nats) whenever the decoder can model the data alone; replicated for a decade across text VAEs. Our KL-to-base anchor + strong frozen decoder is this exact configuration: the anchor is directed pressure to close the channel. Any v10 auxiliary loss touching latent positions must be checked for collapse-pressure sign.

lenses.recipe:
V10 UNDER THE SKEPTIC LENS — every mechanism gets dense supervision AND a control that would have caught the last 10 failures.

CHANNEL (CODI + SIM-CoT recipe, shrunk to budget): (1) Reduce latent prefix 42 → 6-8 tokens (CODI used 6 at 124M; our compression need is smaller than GSM8k's). (2) Joint teacher/student on the SAME adapter per batch: teacher pass teacher-forces the gold synthetic trace [Q, gold steps, A] with CE (exclude the final step from teacher CE to block answer-shortcut, per CODI); student pass gets [Q(masked evidence), <bot>, 6 latents, A]. Losses: L = CE_answer + 1.0·L_distill (smooth-L1 between all-layer hidden states at the answer-emitting token, teacher vs student; CODI α=β=1, γ=1 at GPT-2 scale, lr 3e-3 GPT-2 / 8e-4 at 1B, LoRA r128 — bump our r16 on the channel path if trainable budget allows) + 0.5·L_step (SIM-CoT auxiliary decoder: a small trained decoder head must emit gold step k from latent k, CE per latent, decoder discarded at inference) + 0.3·L_recon (gist autoencoding loss per 2412.17483: latents must reconstruct the withheld premise tokens). DELETE any KL-to-base touching latent positions (1511.06349: that is posterior-collapse pressure by construction); fluency anchoring, if any, only on answer tokens. Keep the masked-evidence rows as the headline metric (physical info asymmetry already kills the 2602.22441 depth-0 shortcut). ~40% of steps on masked rows.
MANDATORY CONTROLS, preregistered as gates: (a) COMPUTE-MATCHED PAUSE ARM — identical run with the 6 latents replaced by learned content-free pause embeddings, same trainable params on that path, same steps (2310.02226/2404.15758). Gate: workspace − pause ≥ +0.10 on masked rows, else verdict = 'compute not content' (this is the single control that retro-explains every past ambiguous gain). (b) STEERING GATE (2512.21711): at audit, Gaussian-perturb / within-family-shuffle the latents; accuracy must DROP ≥ 0.15 absolute — insensitivity = placeholder tokens, mechanism fails even if accuracy is high. (c) PROBE-GENERATION GATE: generation acc on masked rows ≥ probe acc − 0.10 (closes the 0.30/0.000 loophole). (d) Random-gist lower bound (2304.08467-style) scored in the same audit.

EXPERTS: Do NOT learn routing emergently — Mixtral at 47B has no semantic experts and balance losses provably can't prevent identical experts (2204.09179). v10: routing = SUPERVISED CLASSIFICATION. Synthetic data gives free family labels; train the router with plain CE against family (weight 1.0), experts hard-assigned per family during training (straight-through top-1 at eval). If any soft/learned component remains, use the X-MoE fixes: route on an 8-16-dim L2-normalized projection with gating temperature, never raw hidden states. Gates: expert-SWAP counterfactual (force family-A rows through expert B) must cost ≥ 0.10; matched-capacity dense control (same params, no experts) must be beaten, else 'experts = extra capacity' (which is what our v5.x probe-content loss already showed).

LANES: cosine/diversity penalties are documented-inert (2204.09179 saturation; SIM-CoT homogenization; our 9 failures). Replace with structural necessity: each lane receives a PHYSICALLY DISJOINT evidence shard (the masked-channel trick applied per-lane) and carries its own per-lane answer loss through its own head (each lane must solve its shard alone, weight 0.5), fusion loss added only after 25% warmup; lane-dropout p=0.3 so the fusion head cannot rely on one lane. Gate: per-lane ablation each non-null (≥ 0.05 drop) — cosine similarity becomes telemetry, never a gate.

BUDGET: pause-control arm and steering gate are audit/short-train costs, not full duplicates — run pause arm at half steps if needed (a compute-matched control at fewer steps still bounds the compute story). 6-8 latents instead of 42 cuts channel FLOPs ~5x, funding the auxiliary decoder.
lenses.feasibility_at_our_budget: Split verdict. MODEL scale is fine: the only published latent-CoT successes are exactly at 124M-1B (CODI 43.7% GSM8k at GPT-2-124M with LoRA; SIM-CoT stabilizes 124M/8B), so 0.6B frozen+LoRA is in-distribution for the recipe. DATA/COMPUTE scale is not: CODI used 385,620 rows x 40 epochs ≈ 36 A100-hours (roughly 100+ T4-hours); SIM-CoT similar order. Nothing published demonstrates a dense-supervised latent channel at 7.5k-50k rows / 6.5 T4-hours. Two mitigating factors: (1) our synthetic families (1-3 step chains) are far shallower than GSM8k, and CODI's mechanism is distillation of short traces — supervision density per row is what matters, and we can generate unlimited gold step alignments; at 50k rows x short sequences, ~3-5 effective epochs in 6.5h is plausible. (2) The skeptic controls (pause arm, steering, probe-generation gate) are cheap. Honest bottom line: the channel working is maybe 30-40% at this budget even with the full CODI+SIM-CoT stack, and the frozen-base caveat (2310.02226: pause-style tokens help mainly when PRETRAINED in; finetune-only is mixed) argues LoRA may not be enough to teach Qwen3 to consume latent positions at all. Supervised-classifier routing and shard-disjoint lanes are trivially feasible (they are ordinary supervised losses). The decisive design property: with the compute-matched pause arm and steering gate preregistered, EVERY outcome is informative — v10 cannot produce another ambiguous 'probe says yes, generation says no' result.
risks: Compute-not-content unmasking: the pause-control arm matches the workspace arm (predicted by 2310.02226/2404.15758 for parallelizable synthetic families) — prereg this as a decisive, publishable negative, not a failure of the run.

No published evidence for dense-supervised latent channels below ~385k rows; at 7.5k-50k rows the distillation/step losses may underfit and the pre-mortem should budget a 50k-row data expansion (gold traces are free) before blaming the mechanism.

Frozen-base interface: Goyal shows finetune-only pause tokens give mixed/zero gains — Qwen3-0.6B was never pretrained to attend usefully to non-lexical positions; LoRA r16 may be below the interface-learning threshold (CODI used r128).

Shortcut leakage: 2512.21711 and 2602.22441 show latent models preferentially exploit dataset artifacts; any claim row whose answer correlates with family identity or surface features will pass without the channel — masked-evidence construction must cover 100% of headline rows and the audit needs a label-decorrelation check (our v5.6 degenerate-threshold history is this exact failure).

Supervised routing can pass vacuously: a family classifier at 0.6B is near-trivial, so the routing gate must be the expert-swap counterfactual plus a matched-capacity dense control — otherwise 'experts work' is unfalsifiable and repeats the v5.x 'experts stored content' ambiguity.

Strong step supervision collapses latent diversity into re-encoded text CoT (2602.22441 trade-off): the honest claim becomes 'latent EXECUTION of supervised steps at 3-5x token compression', not emergent latent reasoning/search — write the paper claim at that altitude before the run, not after.

lenses.lens: INTERFACE ALTERNATIVES TO PREFIX SPLICING: (a) embedding-layer soft prefix vs (b) per-layer KV prefix vs (c) gated cross-attention vs (d) zero-init attention gating vs (e) hidden-state addition/steering — evaluated for content transmission, LoRA compatibility, and gradient-liveness at init

papers.title: Prefix-Tuning: Optimizing Continuous Prompts for Generation
papers.scale_tested: GPT-2 Medium (345M) and Large (774M), BART-large (400M); E2E (~42k rows), WebNLG (~18k), DART; 0.1% trainable params; single-GPU scale
papers.core_mechanism: Learnable K/V vectors prepended at EVERY attention layer (not embeddings); MLP reparameterization needed for optimization stability; frozen base
papers.measured_result: Matched full fine-tuning on table-to-text at 345M with tens-of-k rows (e.g., E2E BLEU ~69.7 vs 68.2 FT); outperformed FT in low-data (100-500 example) regimes. Direct evidence per-layer KV prefixes train at sub-1B scale on <50k rows

papers.title: P-Tuning v2: Prompt Tuning Can Be Comparable to Fine-tuning Universally Across Scales and Tasks
papers.scale_tested: BERT-large 330M to GLM 10B; SuperGLUE incl. tiny tasks (CB 250 rows, COPA 400, RTE 2.5k)
papers.core_mechanism: Deep per-layer prompts (prefix-tuning applied to NLU); the single change from input-layer-only to every-layer prompts closes the small-model gap
papers.measured_result: At 330M, per-layer prompts match fine-tuning (0.1-3% params) where input-layer prompt tuning (Lester) trails by 10-20+ points; the per-layer vs input-layer delta is largest at small scale — replicated small-scale evidence that interface (b) >> interface (a) below 1B

papers.title: The Power of Scale for Parameter-Efficient Prompt Tuning
papers.scale_tested: T5 60M-11B, SuperGLUE
papers.core_mechanism: Soft prompts at the input embedding layer only (HLWM's failed interface class)
papers.measured_result: Input-layer soft prompts only reach fine-tuning parity at ~10B params; at <1B they are substantially below fine-tuning. NEGATIVE evidence for interface (a) at 0.6B that independently predicts HLWM's channel failures

papers.title: When Do Prompting and Prefix-Tuning Work? A Theory of Capabilities and Limitations
papers.scale_tested: Theory + small transformer constructions/experiments
papers.core_mechanism: Proof that context-based conditioning (soft prompt OR KV prefix) into FROZEN attention cannot change relative attention patterns over content tokens — it can only bias attention output in a fixed per-head direction
papers.measured_result: Formal ceiling: prefixes can elicit pretrained skills but cannot induce new content-extraction behavior in frozen attention. Design implication: the KV-prefix interface must be paired with LoRA on attention (HLWM already has r16 all layers) so the ceiling does not bind

papers.title: LLaMA-Adapter: Efficient Fine-tuning of Language Models with Zero-init Attention
papers.scale_tested: Frozen LLaMA-7B + 1.2M trainable params; 52k Alpaca rows; <1h on 8xA100 (~8 A100-hours); zero-init gate also validated on RoBERTa (355M) and ViT
papers.core_mechanism: K=10 learnable prompt tokens prepended at topmost 30/32 layers. Gate placement is the whole trick (their Eq. 7, verified in full text): attention scores over prompt tokens are softmaxed SEPARATELY from word-token scores and multiplied by learnable per-layer gate g (init 0, tanh-regulated) BEFORE mixing with values; word-token softmax left untouched
papers.measured_result: Alpaca-parity instruction following at 1.2M params; zero-init gating stabilized training and improved final quality vs random init. RECONCILIATION with HLWM's dead gate: their g multiplies post-softmax attention mass INSIDE the attention block — no RMSNorm sits between gate and output, so dL/dg = softmax(S_prompt)·V_prompt·(downstream) is nonzero at g=0. HLWM's scalar scaled a prefix TOKEN EMBEDDING that is immediately per-token RMSNormed — scaling a whole token vector is exactly RMSNorm's invariant direction, hence structurally zero gradient. Zero-init works iff the gate parameterizes a MIXING RATIO downstream of normalization, not a pre-norm magnitude

papers.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
papers.scale_tested: 3B/9B/80B frozen LMs; trained on M3W (43M webpages) + ~1.8B image-text pairs; thousands of TPU-hours
papers.core_mechanism: New gated cross-attention-dense blocks between frozen LM layers; block output multiplied by tanh(alpha), alpha init 0, then ADDED to the residual stream (identity at init)
papers.measured_result: Gates provably open: paper shows |tanh(alpha)| grows monotonically during training at all depths; content (not style) transfer proven via captioning/VQA. Why theirs opened vs HLWM's died: the gate scales a vector ADDED to the residual stream — this changes residual DIRECTION, which pre-LN normalization does not cancel, so the gradient is live; HLWM's gate scaled a normalized token's magnitude. But all content-transfer evidence is at >=3B params and 10^8-10^9 pairs — the architecture lesson transfers, the feasibility evidence does not

papers.title: In-context Autoencoder for Context Compression in a Large Language Model (ICAE)
papers.scale_tested: Llama-7B: LoRA-adapted encoder + FROZEN decoder; autoencoding+LM pretraining on a large web corpus (order 10^6 samples), then instruction fine-tuning; ~1% added params
papers.core_mechanism: k memory-slot tokens appended to context; their last-layer outputs become an embedding-layer soft prefix for the frozen decoder; trained with explicit RECONSTRUCTION loss (decode original text from slots alone) before any task use
papers.measured_result: BLEU >95% reconstructing 500-token contexts from k=128 slots (4x compression); fidelity collapses at k=32-64 (>8x). Proves embedding-layer prefixes CAN carry verbatim content into a frozen decoder — but only when a dense reconstruction objective forces it, and demonstrated only at 7B with ~10^6 training samples

papers.title: 500xCompressor: Generalized Prompt Compression for Large Language Models
papers.scale_tested: Frozen Llama-3-8B-Instruct encoder with LoRA r=64 + frozen same-model decoder; pretrain 42k-104k steps, batch 4, lr 1e-4, 300 warmup (~170k-415k ArXiv-abstract sequences); finetune 10k-20k steps lr 5e-5 on 250k ArxivQA pairs (verified from ACL PDF Table 7)
papers.core_mechanism: Head-to-head interface comparison: compressed tokens delivered as PER-LAYER KV pairs instead of ICAE's last-layer embeddings; decoder needs no fine-tuning at all
papers.measured_result: KV-values interface beats embedding interface at every compression ratio (lower eval loss than ICAE throughout training); 1 token retains 62-74% F1 / 77-84% EM of uncompressed QA, 16 tokens near-lossless for <=500-token contexts; proper nouns and NUMBERS survive compression (content, not style). The only direct (a)-vs-(b) content-transfer measurement in the literature — per-layer KV wins

papers.title: xRAG: Extreme Context Compression for Retrieval-augmented Generation with One Token
papers.scale_tested: Frozen Mistral-7B / Mixtral 8x7B + frozen retriever; ONLY a 2-layer MLP projector trained; paraphrase pretraining then instruction tuning with self-distillation
papers.core_mechanism: One document embedding projected into token space of the frozen LM; key loss: KL DISTILLATION TO THE TEXT-CONDITIONED TEACHER (same model with the real document in context) — pulls the channel open toward the conditioned distribution
papers.measured_result: +10% average over no-retrieval across 6 knowledge tasks with a single soft token. Directly indicts HLWM's KL-to-unconditioned-base (which is directed close-the-channel pressure); the correct anchor is KL-to-premise-conditioned-teacher

papers.title: Training Large Language Models to Reason in a Continuous Latent Space (Coconut)
papers.scale_tested: GPT-2 small 124M (FULL fine-tune, not frozen); ProsQA 17,886 synthetic rows; lr 1e-4, effective batch 128, 6 curriculum stages x 5 epochs + rest to 50 epochs; small-lab compute
papers.core_mechanism: Last hidden state fed back as next input embedding (continuous thought); STAGED CURRICULUM replaces gold CoT steps with latent thoughts one step per stage; CE loss on remaining gold-trace tokens forces the latent to carry the removed reasoning content
papers.measured_result: ProsQA 97.0% vs CoT 77.5% vs No-CoT ~76%; ablation: WITHOUT the curriculum, latent training performs no better than direct answer generation. Strongest existence proof that per-row latent REASONING content transfers at 124M with ~18k synthetic rows — contingent on a gold-trace curriculum, which is HLWM's stated free asset. 2025-26 follow-ups replicate the setup (supervision-strength study arXiv:2602.22441; causal analysis arXiv:2512.21711 cautions latent tokens are not always causally load-bearing — audit needed)

papers.title: Towards a Unified View of Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning
papers.scale_tested: BART-large/RoBERTa/mBART (~400M) on XSum, MT, GLUE
papers.core_mechanism: Derivation: prefix-tuning is exactly a GATED ADDITIVE modification of attention output, h <- (1-lambda(x))·Attn(x) + lambda(x)·Attn_prefix(x), where lambda(x) = softmax mass on the prefix — i.e., interface (b) has a built-in input-dependent post-softmax gate
papers.measured_result: Their scaled parallel-adapter/MAM design beats prefix-tuning at ~400M (XSum ROUGE); gives the formal account of why KV-prefix gradients are live at small scale while embedding-magnitude gates are not: the effective gate is attention mass, not a pre-norm scalar

papers.title: Style Vectors for Steering Generative Large Language Models (+ steering-limits literature)
papers.scale_tested: Llama-2-7B class; inference-time residual-stream vector addition, no training
papers.core_mechanism: Interface (e): fixed vector added to hidden states at a chosen layer (difference-of-means or trained style vectors)
papers.measured_result: Reliably shifts STYLE/sentiment; outputs degenerate into keyword repetition at strength lambda>=0.75; converging findings across the steering literature (e.g., limits study arXiv:2607.01802, CAV analyses): steering moves behavioral tendencies but CANNOT inject specific facts/entity-level content. Interface (e) is disqualified for HLWM's per-row premise-content channel; useful only as a cheap style/abstention-bias knob

lenses.recipe: V10 CHANNEL INTERFACE — replace the embedding-layer 42-token prefix with a per-layer gated KV prefix, and make content transfer the explicit training objective. (1) INJECTION: sidecar workspace -> shared trunk -> per-layer low-rank heads emitting m=16 KV slots per layer for all 28 Qwen3-0.6B layers, shaped to its GQA layout (8 KV heads x head_dim 128); low-rank per-layer heads (r=64, 500xCompressor's LoRA rank) keep this ~10-20M params. Slots are appended directly to each layer's K/V — they never pass through RMSNorm as tokens, killing the inertness failure class structurally. (2) GATING (LLaMA-Adapter Eq. 7): softmax the attention scores over the 16 prefix slots SEPARATELY from word-token scores; multiply the prefix branch by tanh(g_{l,h}), per-layer-per-head, init 0; leave the word branch unscaled. Gradient at init is softmax(S_prefix)·V_prefix·(downstream) != 0 — live by construction; add a build-time unit test asserting ||dL/dg|| > 0 at step 0. Never place any learnable scalar on a pre-RMSNorm embedding again. (3) SUPERVISION (dense; uses the gold-trace asset — this is what every successful content-transfer paper had and every HLWM failure lacked): Stage A "reconstruction pretrain" (~1000 of 3200 steps): premise physically masked (keep v9 machinery); decoder must emit the full gold reasoning trace + premise restatement conditioned ONLY on the KV prefix + a fixed [RECON] cue; token CE on ~150 trace tokens/row = ~20x denser signal per row than answer-only loss (ICAE/500x recipe: lr 1e-4, AdamW, 300 warmup steps — 500x's exact schedule). KILL GATE at step 1000: held-out reconstruction token-F1 < 0.5 => interface dead, stop the run (~2 GPU-h early kill). Stage B "trace-deletion curriculum" (~1500 steps, Coconut): delete the first k gold-trace steps and require correct continuation from the prefix, k ramping over 3 stages (not Coconut's 6 — budget); CE on remaining trace + answer; grad-accum >=16 (Coconut used effective batch 128; curriculum transitions are unstable at small batch). Stage C (~700 steps): existing masked-row task loss + scoring heads/conformal stack unchanged (the part that works). (4) KL: delete KL-to-base entirely; if an anchor is needed use xRAG's self-distillation — KL to the SAME base with the true premise in-context, weight 0.5. (5) LoRA r16 all layers stays: it is what lifts the frozen-attention expressiveness ceiling of arXiv:2310.19698. (6) LANES/EXPERTS through this interface: give each lane a DISJOINT layer band (lane 1 injects layers 4-13, lane 2 layers 14-23) and each expert a disjoint slot group with hard top-1 masking supervised by the free synthetic family labels for the first 50% of steps — lane cosine collapse becomes structurally impossible to be equivalent (streams enter different computation stages), and routing gets dense supervision instead of emergent hope. (7) AUDIT: keep the within-family shuffled-prefix control; add gate-zeroing ablation (all g=0 at eval) as the causal necessity measurement; per-layer g trajectories are telemetry only (gates should visibly open by ~step 500 per Flamingo's trajectories, but arXiv:2512.21711 warns open gates alone do not prove causal use). DATA: expand to 20-50k synthetic rows if throughput allows — every successful frozen-decoder content-transfer result used >=10^5 dense-supervised sequences except Coconut's 18k x 50 epochs; at 3200 steps x accum 16 you see ~51k row-presentations (~1-2.5 effective epochs) — Stage A's per-token density is what must compensate.
lenses.feasibility_at_our_budget: Split verdict, stated honestly. TRAINABILITY of the interface at 0.6B: well supported — per-layer KV prefixes reached fine-tuning parity at 345M (Prefix-Tuning: E2E/WebNLG, 18-42k rows) and 330M (P-Tuning v2: SuperGLUE tasks down to 250 rows), squarely inside the 7.5k-50k-row, single-GPU regime; and the gate-liveness fix (post-softmax mixing-ratio gate) is an equation-level architectural correction, not a scale bet. PER-ROW CONTENT TRANSFER into a FROZEN decoder: the only sub-1B evidence is Coconut — 124M, 17.9k synthetic rows, 97% vs 77.5% CoT — but it full-fine-tuned the base and spent 50 epochs; the frozen-base+LoRA compression results (ICAE 4x BLEU>95; 500xCompressor 16-token near-lossless with numbers preserved) are 7-8B only, trained on 10^5-10^6 sequences over 50-120k optimizer steps vs our 3200. So no single precedent guarantees the full pipeline at 6.5 T4-hours. What IS defensible: (i) Stage-A reconstruction shows clear life or clear death within ~1000 steps because token-level CE on ~150-token traces gives ~20x the per-row gradient signal of v9's answer-only loss — a cheap falsifiable checkpoint; (ii) the interface change removes the two mechanisms already proven to have actively closed the old channel (RMSNorm-inert gate, KL-to-base); (iii) LoRA-all-layers puts us closer to Coconut's full-FT condition than to pure prompt tuning. Expect Stage A to pass; treat Stage B/C transfer as the genuine experiment. If 6.5h forces cuts, cut Stage C rows, never Stage A density; expanding to 30-50k rows is the highest-leverage free move the literature supports.
risks: Expressiveness ceiling (arXiv:2310.19698): even per-layer KV prefixes cannot create NEW attention patterns in frozen heads, only bias outputs; mitigation is LoRA on attention, but the KV-prefix + LoRA-r16 combination at 0.6B is untested anywhere, and if LoRA capacity is spent on task loss the ceiling may still bind for premise extraction

Compute/data gap: every frozen-decoder content-compression success used 10^5-10^6 dense-supervised sequences and 50k-120k steps (500x: 42-104k pretrain steps at 8B); we have 3200 steps — reconstruction may plateau at partial fidelity, and ICAE's BLEU collapse beyond 4x compression suggests 16 slots for a multi-fact premise could be under-capacity at 0.6B where representations are weaker

Reconstruction != use: ICAE/500x show a QA gap vs uncompressed contexts even when regeneration is near-lossless, and arXiv:2512.21711 shows latent thoughts can be causally inert while metrics look good — Stage A can pass while Stage C masked-row accuracy stays near 0; shuffled-prefix and g=0 ablations must be the headline gates, not gate magnitudes

Curriculum fragility: Coconut's ablation shows no-curriculum == no-CoT, and its recipe used effective batch 128 and 50 epochs; with grad-accum 16 on T4 and ~1-2.5 effective epochs, the staged trace-deletion may not converge — pre-register a 3-stage ramp and accept partial-trace latency rather than full latency

GQA/QK-norm plumbing: Qwen3-0.6B has 8 KV heads vs 16 query heads AND applies per-head RMSNorm to Q and K (QK-norm) — the split-softmax gate must sit AFTER QK-norm or the scale-invariance failure recurs in a new location; ship a unit test that perturbs g at init and asserts output-logit change

Multi-mechanism confound: new interface + new supervision + curriculum shipped together makes a pass uninterpretable for mechanism claims; pre-register g=0 and shuffled-prefix ablations plus, if budget allows, an old-interface (embedding-prefix) control arm trained with the same Stage-A/B losses, since dense reconstruction alone might rescue even interface (a)

# V10 Channel Recipe (Channel Lead)

## 1. Chosen supervision recipe: CODI self-distillation core + CoLaR grounding + reconstruction kill-gate

The lenses converge on one diagnosis: probe-0.30/generation-0.000 is exactly CODI's "w/o L1" ablation (43.7→24.5, arXiv:2502.21074), CoLaR's -OC ablation (arXiv:2505.16552), and the numbers-probe literature (arXiv:2602.07812) — answer-only supervision leaves latents decoder-illegible. The fix, unanimous across six independent lenses, is a **dense token-level loss on the generation-side interface**.

**Data/teacher construction:** For every synthetic row, emit a gold compact trace in GSM8k-Aug equation style (`<<a op b = c>>`), ≤24 tokens. **Exclude the final answer-producing step from teacher CE** (CODI: keeping it costs 12 pts via copy shortcut). Expand to 30–50k rows — traces are free and data is the cheapest lever; every lens flags exposure as the binding constraint.

**Latent budget:** K=6 tokens, not 42. Every published success uses 3–13 (CODI peaks at exactly 6); long latent chains are the collapse regime and Coconut collapses at 5+ latents in SIM-CoT's replication.

**Losses, single stage after a short warm phase (no token-removal curriculum — ICoT-SI seed-dependent permanent collapse, arXiv:2405.14838 Fig 4; CODI's single-stage design exists because curriculum forgetting cost Coconut/iCoT 10–20 pts):**

- **Warm phase, steps 0–800 (kill gate):** decoder conditioned ONLY on latent prefix + fixed `[RECON]` cue must reconstruct premise + trace, teacher-forced CE weight 1.0 (ICAE arXiv:2307.06945, 500xCompressor arXiv:2408.03094). **Hard gate at ~800 steps: held-out digit-level exact-match ≥0.98** (gate on digits, not BLEU — "lost-if-surprise," arXiv:2412.17483). Fail → channel dead for structural reasons, abort at ~1.5 GPU-h.
- **Main phase:** L = 1.0·CE_teacher(Q+trace+A, same LoRA) + 1.0·CE_student(A | Q, 6 latents) + γ·smooth-L1(student vs teacher hidden states at the pre-answer token, all layers, per-layer std-normalized, stop-grad teacher; γ=1, raise toward 20 if the distill/CE magnitude ratio is small — CODI's 1B finding) + 0.5·CE_grounding (CoLaR: teacher-force latents as compressed gold-trace embeddings, sum of c∈[1,3] token embeddings/√c, per-position CE — fully parallel, the only variant whose FLOPs fit T4) + 0.3·continued reconstruction (prevents drift back to collapse; arXiv:2412.17483).
- **Delete KL-to-base entirely.** It is distillation to a teacher WITHOUT the premise — directed close-the-channel pressure (posterior-collapse form, arXiv:1511.06349); v8 measured this in-house. If an anchor is needed: token-KL to the SAME model WITH premise in-context, weight 0.5, stop-grad (xRAG arXiv:2405.13792; prompt-distillation arXiv:2412.14964 shows this works at r=16, thousands of rows).

**Optimization:** LoRA rank ≥64 (r128 if VRAM allows; CODI's only LoRA evidence is r128, and r16 is in the measured "learns less" regime for math, arXiv:2405.09673 — all-modules targeting beats 16× rank). lr 8e-4 (CODI's 1B value), cosine + 3% warmup, AdamW wd 0.1. **Effective batch ≥32–64 via grad-accum** — the L1 term's batch-statistics normalization is noise at accum-4. Free-running student decodes on ≤25% of steps; CoLaR grounding (teacher-forced) carries the rest.

**Preregistered gates (skeptic lens):** masked-premise rows remain headline; within-family shuffled-prefix control; **compute-matched pause arm** (6 content-free learned embeddings, same params/steps — gate: workspace − pause ≥ +0.10, else verdict "compute not content"; arXiv:2310.02226/2404.15758); steering gate (perturbed latents must drop accuracy ≥0.15, else placeholders — arXiv:2512.21711); probe-generation gate (generation ≥ probe − 0.10). Gate the claim at **margin over No-CoT/shuffled control, NOT CoT parity** — parity needed 385k rows everywhere it was measured.

## 2. Interface decision: per-layer KV prefix with post-softmax gating

**Per-layer KV prefix**, projected via a 2-layer bottleneck MLP into Qwen3's GQA layout (8 KV heads × 128), all 28 layers. Evidence: input-embedding soft tokens are known-weak below ~1B (Lester arXiv:2104.08691 — parity only near 10B); per-layer injection rescues sub-1B (prefix-tuning matches full FT at 345M on 18–42k rows, arXiv:2101.00190; P-Tuning v2 at 330M, arXiv:2110.07602); 500xCompressor measured KV > embedding injection directly. HLWM's 42-token embedding prefix sat on the wrong side of this scale cliff for four versions.

**RMSNorm reconciliation:** our gate died because it scaled a pre-RMSNorm token embedding — magnitude is RMSNorm's invariant direction, so ∂L/∂g is structurally zero. LLaMA-Adapter (arXiv:2303.16199) and Flamingo gates work because they parameterize a **mixing ratio downstream of normalization**: split the softmax over prefix slots vs word tokens, multiply the prefix branch by tanh(g) per-layer-per-head, init 0 — gradient at init is softmax(S_prefix)·V_prefix·(downstream) ≠ 0. Place it AFTER Qwen3's QK-norm or the failure recurs. **Ship a build-time unit test asserting ‖∂L/∂g‖ > 0 and output-logit change under g-perturbation at step 0.** If KV plumbing into GQA is too risky, embedding injection is acceptable at our <2× compression ratio only if it passes the warm-phase reconstruction gate.

## 3. Frozen-base/LoRA verdict: COMPATIBLE, with a rank caveat

Yes. CODI is the direct proof: frozen GPT-2 124M and LLaMA-3.2-1B learn to *read* a latent prefix through LoRA alone (r128 a32) — bracketing 0.6B. CoLaR is explicitly frozen-1B + LoRA + external latent head — our exact architecture class. ICAE/500xCompressor show even a zero-trainable-param frozen reader consumes latents when the writer trains through it with reconstruction CE. Unfreezing attention is not required; LoRA-all-layers also lifts the frozen-attention expressiveness ceiling (arXiv:2310.19698). Caveat: no LoRA evidence exists at r16 — budget the rank bump.

## 4. Failures structurally prevented vs. not

**Prevented:** (a) gate inertness — post-softmax mixing-ratio gate, liveness unit-tested at step 0; (b) KL-to-base closing the channel — deleted/flipped to premise-conditioned self-teacher; (c) answer-only sparse supervision (the root collapse cause) — ~100+ CE/L1 terms per row vs v9's ~5; (d) 42-token collapse regime — K=6; (e) embedding-level scale cliff — per-layer KV; (f) scaffold/register pathology — latents never occupy token positions at decode; (g) ambiguous verdicts — pause arm + steering gate make every outcome informative; (h) probe-yes/generation-no loophole — probe-generation gate plus the L1 term that specifically closes it.

**NOT prevented:** (i) data/compute underfit — every headline result used 385k rows × 10–40 epochs, ~36–48 A100-h; our ~50–100k row-visits is a 5–100× extrapolation, mitigated only by trivially-easy synthetic families and the CCoT 9k-row half-gain datapoint (arXiv:2412.13171); (ii) reconstruction ≠ task transfer — the warm gate can pass while masked accuracy stays low (ICAE QA gap); preregister the split result as its own rung; (iii) shortcut pseudo-reasoning — gates detect it, nothing prevents it (arXiv:2512.21711, 2602.22441); (iv) teacher ceiling — KL target is bounded by 0.6B-with-premise accuracy per band (measure first); (v) supervision-diversity trade-off — strong step supervision collapses hypothesis diversity; do not stack exploration claims on these latents.

## 5. Fallback (if primary exceeds 6.5 GPU-h)

Drop free-running student passes and SIM-CoT-style auxiliaries entirely; run **100% CoLaR teacher-forced grounding** (fully parallel, frozen-base-verified; its -OC ablation shows only ~1.6 pts lost at scale) + the L1 distill term + warm-phase reconstruction, K=6, embedding injection with std-normalized latents (skip KV plumbing). If even that misses throughput: **SoftCoT minimal arm** (arXiv:2502.12134) — latents = frozen base's own hidden states over the gold trace at 6–16 anchors through ONE trainable linear map, the only recipe validated at exactly 7,473 rows/1 GPU; preregister a +1–3 pt effect over shuffled control, which is all that datapoint supports.

# HLWM v10 — Merged Recipe: "Dense Supervision or Structural Necessity, Nowhere Emergent Hope"

**Thesis.** All ten failures share one signature: components training never *forces* to be useful collapse. v10 eliminates emergence as a load-bearing assumption: the channel gets ~100+ dense CE/L1 terms per row (vs v9's ~5), experts get deterministic label routing where collapse is impossible by construction, and lanes — zero positive evidence at ≤1B anywhere — are cut as a claim.

---

## 0. Conflict resolutions (binding)

1. **Step budget.** Protocol's throughput-derived ledger governs: **2,200 joint steps** (floor 2,000), not v9's 3,200. Channel's warm phase rescales to **steps 0–600** (kill gate at 600, ~1.4 GPU-h abort point); StableMoE Stage-2 switch rescales from 2,600 → **step 1,800**.
2. **Effective batch.** Grad-accum 16 (eff. batch 16), not channel's ≥32–64. Channel's batch-statistics concern is resolved by **EMA-std normalization** of the L1 distill term instead of batch-std. Deviation from CODI's 128 disclosed.
3. **γ (distill weight).** Smoke phase calibrates: start 10, sweep {5, 20}. Supersedes channel's start-at-1.
4. **Data volume.** Emit **25k rows**, not channel's 30–50k: the binding constraint is presentations (~8.8k, single epoch), so extra rows buy nothing consumable; audit/calibration/banding pools draw from the 25k.
5. **"Curriculum" vs single-stage.** Channel's warm phase is a loss-weight ramp inside one run — no optimizer reset, no token removal. The banned class (iCoT-SI token-removal transitions, arXiv:2405.14838) is not this. Compatible.
6. **Interface × expert placement.** The KV-prefix projector (writer→reader) is one shared module, never routed. **Shared expert = the r64 all-layer backbone LoRA** (also the channel carrier) — this directly implements DeepSeekMoE isolation and absorbs the common content that made v5.6.2 expert removal costly. **Routed experts = 2× r16 LoRA on decoder MLP projections only.** Matched-capacity dense control = one r32 MLP LoRA (same trainable params as the routed pair).
7. **Rank.** r64, not r128 — joint teacher+student passes on 16GB T4s make r128 a memory gamble; r128 is a named fallback only if smoke shows headroom. Trainable-param delta vs v9's 132M disclosed in prereg.
8. **Cut-order conflict.** Protocol listed the expert-swap audit arm as cut #2; structure correctly makes the cross-routing ablation + dense control the *entire* expert claim (unfalsifiable without them). Resolved cut order: (1) lanes arm, (2) SMEAR arm, (3) fresh audit rows 720→576 (deficit moved to the e-process extension session), (4) steps to the 2,000 floor. **Never cut:** cross-routing ablation, dense control, masked-premise + shuffled-prefix gates, w/o-L1 ablation, discrete semantic-entropy baseline.
9. **Lanes.** Structure says cut; protocol says exploratory-first-cut. **Resolution: CUT as a claim.** Nine cosine-0.94–0.98 failures plus the literature (repulsive ensembles buy no accuracy, arXiv:2306.02775; supervision aligns representations regardless, arXiv:2602.00533) predict distinctness-without-consumption. Lanes are also downstream of the channel — unevaluable if it dies. The disjoint-evidence-shard design (per-lane masked shards, per-lane heads, lane-dropout 0.3, asymmetric predictor) survives only as named fallback **LANES-X**, contingent on the mid-run channel gate passing AND throughput ≥10% under budget. ## 6. Top 8 risks (each mapped to the 10-study collapse pattern)

1. **Exposure underfit** — every published channel success used 385k rows × 10–40 epochs; we extrapolate 5–100× down. *Mitigation:* trivially-easy families + 20% easy stratum; gate on margin-over-control, never parity; preregistered MDE so a null is bounded, not ambiguous.
2. **Reconstruction passes, transfer fails** (ICAE QA gap) — the warm gate can pass while masked accuracy stays 0. *Mitigation:* separate preregistered rungs; step-1,200 masked-acc go/no-go; abort branch is the *better-powered* abstention audit.
3. **Inert-auxiliary recurrence** (killed gates in v5–v9 via RMSNorm invariance / zero-init). *Mitigation:* post-softmax tanh gate placed after QK-norm; no zero-init on any router/gate path; blocking step-0 grad-liveness test for every term — no GPU commit without it.
4. **Engineering crash repeat** (sessions B, D, G all crashed on code defects). *Mitigation:* manifest code-sha verification before GPU commitment; resume-glob checkpoints; the new cross-conformal and KV-plumbing paths get dedicated unit tests; deterministic zip.
5. **Cross-routing ablation null → experts are pure capacity** (v5.6.2 predicts this). *Mitigation:* it cannot be silently dodged — preregistered negative-evidence re-scope; dense r32 control makes the comparison falsifiable either way.
6. **Latents become trace relays / shortcut pseudo-reasoning** (probe-yes/gen-no reappearing as copy). *Mitigation:* answer step excluded from teacher CE; steering, shuffled-prefix, and pause-arm gates make every outcome informative; no diversity/exploration claims stacked on supervised latents.
7. **Teacher ceiling** — distillation target bounded by 0.6B-with-premise accuracy per difficulty band. *Mitigation:* measure teacher-with-premise accuracy per band in smoke/banding before training; bands where the teacher fails are excluded from channel gates.
8. **Abstention power shortfall again** (v9's f-bar was a disguised underpowered p-test). *Mitigation:* DeLong/Stouffer primary + sequential e-process extension to ~4,600 rows; band mix targets acc 0.5–0.65; semantic-entropy baseline mandatory; ranking claim never conflated with the coverage/risk-UCB guarantee.

**Priority under slip: channel > experts > lanes(cut). Failure of the channel at any gate converts the session into the fully-powered abstention study — the failure branch is a publishable result, not a lost session.**
critique:
(a) Load-bearing claims with no measured support

1. **Warm kill gate: digit-EM ≥0.98 at step 600 with K=6.** Every lens's reconstruction-feasibility argument assumed 42–64 slots for ~25-token premises (ratio <2x); the recipe adopted CODI's K=6 but kept an ICAE-style gate now demanding ~9x compression of premise+trace, at 0.6B, in 600 steps — no sub-7B evidence at any step count. The collapse-theory lens proposed ≥0.9 at ~1000–1300 steps. The threshold is a merge artifact, never re-derived.
2. **Pause-arm margin ≥ +0.10.** The only frozen-base, ≤10k-row measured effect is SoftCoT's +1–3 pts (on 7–8B). Coconut's +19.5 was full-FT × 50 epochs. A real, literature-consistent +3–5 pt effect fails this gate and gets mislabeled "compute not content."
3. **Cross-conformal reclamation (~256 rows/seed) + e-process top-up.** Load-bearing for Primary A's power, budgeted "~0h," self-described "new code path — needs tests." Sessions B, D, G all died on exactly this class.
4. **Shared-expert-absorbs-content via backbone LoRA.** DeepSeekMoE isolation is measured at 2B+ full models; "an r64 backbone LoRA functions as shared expert" is unmeasured anywhere.

(b) Falsified patterns that snuck back in

- **Zero-init gate, again.** §1 specifies `tanh(g), init 0` per-layer-per-head; §6 risk 3 promises "no zero-init on any router/gate path" — an internal contradiction. Post-softmax placement fixes the RMSNorm invariance, and [LLaMA-Adapter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.16199) validates the form — but at 7B/52k rows. At g=0, **∂L/∂(prefix-projector params) = 0**: content learns only after the gate opens (v8's α froze at 0.050 for an entire run). Worse, the blocking step-0 test checks only ‖∂L/∂g‖, which is nonzero even when the content path is dead — a test that certifies a broken instrument, the exact v8 leak-gate failure class. Fix: test ‖∂L/∂prefix-params‖ too, and init g so tanh(g)≈0.05–0.1.
- **KL pressure, softened not removed.** The "optional anchor" (token-KL to self-with-premise, weight 0.5) is v9's distillation-teacher flip — which shipped in v9 and the channel still hit 0.000. It carries zero positive in-house evidence and 0.5 is heavy.

(c) Single biggest unmitigated risk

**The step-600 abort is an unvalidated one-way door.** Everything downstream (channel, experts' consumption context, both audits' row mix) keys off a threshold (0.98/600/K=6) no lens measured and no smoke phase calibrates. A false abort silently converts v10 into the abstention-only study and terminally retires the channel program on an artifact. Mitigation is cheap: log the reconstruction learning curve in smoke/warm, prereg the gate as trajectory-based (EM slope + level band), or calibrate the threshold on the first 200 warm steps.

(d) What the sweep missed entirely: **multi-objective gradient conflict.**

The main-phase loss stacks 5+ terms (teacher CE, student CE, γ·L1 with γ∈{5,20}, CoLaR CE, reconstruction, plus router/probe CEs) on shared r64 LoRA params, with weights hand-set from a ~33-step-per-γ smoke. No lens examined destructive interference, yet it's the canonical failure mode: [PCGrad / Gradient Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.06782) (Yu et al.) shows conflicting task gradients — negative cosine + magnitude disparity, which γ=10–20 L1 vs weight-1.0 CE guarantees — stall the weaker objectives; reconstruction (memorize premise) and hidden-state distillation (match teacher) plausibly conflict directly. At 2,200 steps there is no time to escape a stall. Minimum viable mitigation: log per-term grad-norms and pairwise grad-cosines every 100 steps (near-free), prereg an interference diagnostic; PCGrad itself is a drop-in optimizer wrapper if smoke shows conflict.

Also absent from the recipe: the **plain-LoRA control**, still unrun after 10 studies (moe-collapse lens flags it); the r32 control covers experts only, not "does the whole sidecar beat vanilla LoRA SFT."
